transcript: There have been whisperings that Come From Away could be headed back to broadway. Especially with the 25th anniversary of 9/11 this fall. I don't know if this is true, but I need it to be. Specifically this reimagined version of the musical currently playing at Paper Mill Playhouse in Milburn, New Jersey. I got to go to opening night and while watching it, I couldn't stop thinking abou how relevant this story still is and how much everyone needs to see it right now. If you don't know Come From Away this is a story about how people come together during unimaginable fear. How choosing kindness and generosity and compassion can lead to something truly extraordinary. It reminds us how even in the darkest of moments, we can still show up for each other. I've seen a lot of shows at paper mill playhouse, and this is by far the best thing i've ever seen here. I was completely blown away by the cast and the creative choices. The set is stunning and has so many magical moments. And the lighting is breathtaking. And the way that instruments are woven into the performances makes everything feel so communal. Come From Away is currently playing until March 1st and I hope everyone gets to see it. But more than that I truly hope that this show finds its way to broadway. It would be more than a revival. It would be a reminder of who we can be at our best and of what community care can look like. Come From Away isn't just a story about the past. It speaks directly to the present. And it's a powerful example of how community care and courage can light the way forward.
classificationReason: Creator discusses a production at Paper Mill Playhouse and speculates about potential Broadway return, but Come From Away is not on the provided list
